display_name: Daily Studio Chair Reconstruction & Memory Synthesis
title: Daily Studio Chair Reconstruction & Memory Synthesis
short_summary: Harvests one high-resolution single-chair photograph on a solid white background from up to 5 curated design RSS feeds within a strict 5-call budget over the last 24 hours, reconstructs it 1-to-1 in pure procedural photorealistic Three.js against a seamless white cyclorama with a soft floor shadow bottom using tilt-shift camera matching and 4x RGSS cinema optics, and synthesizes a brand-new original chair side-by-side from cumulative daily memory and designer notes. Use when running the daily chair design agent, reconstructing a studio furniture photograph 1-to-1 in Three.js, or generating memory-informed procedural chair designs side-by-side. Don't use for multi-building landscape scenes (use arch-turing-test-loop) or static 2D HTML marketing pages (use jason-dev-agent).
